At the 2026 World Cup, Lionel Messi wrote another chapter in his legendary story, this time at the age of 39. He was not just Argentina’s captain; he was the player who stepped up in the biggest moments, scoring 8 goals and providing 4 assists as he led Argentina all the way to the final. Messi entered the tournament as if age were nothing more than a number. He scored, created chances, delivered in the knockout stages, and against England in the semi-final, he provided two assists to send Argentina into yet another World Cup final. But the most special part was that the 2026 World Cup became his final chapter with Argentina. After the tournament, Messi announced his retirement from international football, leaving behind an extraordinary legacy: 21 World Cup goals, 12 assists, and six World Cup appearances. 39 years old. Six World Cups. Three finals. And still, Messi was Messi. His journey with Argentina may have come to an end, but the story he wrote in the blue and white will forever remain one of the greatest stories football has ever witnessed. 🇦🇷🐐 #messi
